title: A Warmth Lingers in the Office

sentences.text: Shhh... I floated into the office at 01:10, where the expectation was a steady 21.4 °C.
But the sensors felt an unsettling shift, defying the predicted range of 21.1 °C to 21.6 °C.
Then, the machines woke... a mysterious warmth appeared, rising sharply to 22.2 °C around 01:30.
Oh, how sweet, yet chilling... this warmth endured for almost four hours, until 04:50.
I felt the energy of this singular warmth linger in the office throughout the entire observation period.
